item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Ajay shining a torch at three sheets P, Q and R. Through P almost all the light passes and shapes look clear. Through Q only some light passes and shapes look unclear. Through R no light passes.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: Q is translucent because only some light passes and shapes look unclear.
options.B: Q is transparent because some light passes through it.
options.C: Q is opaque because shapes look unclear.
options.D: P is translucent because almost all the light passes through it.
